parts.note: spelling here means casting spells, not putting letters in order, so the aid is a conjuror's prop

explanation.definitionFit: A conjuror's stick is the classic tool for casting a spell.

clue.text: Have an unsuitable partner in the union

definitions.text: Have an unsuitable partner in the union

parts.words: Have an unsuitable partner in the union
parts.note: union reads like a trade union, but it is a marriage or pairing where the two parties are badly suited

explanation.surface: A trade unionist is lumbered with an awkward colleague.
explanation.definitionFit: To pair things badly, or a poorly suited pairing, is the sense of this word.

indicators.note: about signals that the letters of the words before it are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: A book about a bush, or someone reading up on one.
explanation.walkthrough: Reading looks like the Berkshire town or the act of reading; it is just fodder. 'about' rearranges READING into GARDENI, and A follows.
explanation.definitionFit: This fragrant white-flowered evergreen is a well-known ornamental bush.

clue.text: Tea can be removed from chain

indicators.note: removed is read as re-moved, moved again, so the letters of tea and can are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A tea caddy taken off a chain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be removed' looks like taking the tin away; read 'removed' as 'moved about', an anagram of TEA CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A connected series or linked sequence is the Latin-derived term's meaning, also used in chemistry and philosophy.

definitions.meaning: feeling relaxed and at ease, as in your own house
a party or gathering held in a private house, an old-fashioned social event

explanation.definitionFit: One means at ease in a setting; the other is a social party given in one's house.

indicators.note: falsely suggests the letters of is stated are put together wrongly, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone's dislike is misreported.
explanation.walkthrough: 'falsely' rearranges IS STATED into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Dislike or a strong feeling of repugnance is a synonym of aversion.

clue.text: Deity did not stand up for 12 months

parts.note: someone who did not stand up stayed seated, so sat
twelve months make a year, abbreviated yr

explanation.surface: A god who stayed seated for a whole year.
explanation.definitionFit: This woodland god of Greek myth, half man and half goat, is a minor deity.

clue.text: Part of mind having splendid personality

parts.note: super is an informal word for splendid or excellent
ego means one's sense of self or personality

explanation.surface: A person whose mind and character are both admirable.
explanation.definitionFit: In Freud's model the conscience-like element of the psyche is one of its three parts.

parts.note: strikes suggests industrial action, but it is a clock chiming the hour, which gives the most strokes at noon or midnight

explanation.surface: When industrial action is most frequent.
explanation.definitionFit: A striking clock sounds the greatest number of chimes at noon and midnight.

parts.note: a rat is a deserter or turncoat
tan is a light brown colour

explanation.surface: A traitor armed with a brown walking stick.
explanation.definitionFit: The stems of this climbing palm are used as canes for furniture and walking sticks.

definitions.meaning: a minor graze on the skin
in golf a player with zero handicap plays off this mark

explanation.surface: A minor wound that is no real hindrance.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cut or graze; also a golfing term for a zero handicap, the line from which unhandicapped racers start.

definitions.meaning: level or on a smooth surface, with no slopes
horse racing over a course with no fences or hurdles, as opposed to steeplechasing

explanation.definitionFit: Literally on level ground; in horse racing, flat races are those with no fences to clear.

indicators.note: ruined suggests the words in water are wrecked and their letters reassembled

explanation.surface: Tin cans left rusting in the rain.
explanation.definitionFit: Ware made of tin-plated metal covers kitchen pots, cans and other vessels.

parts.note: spot of drinking looks like a small drink, but spot means a place where liquor is sold without a licence

explanation.surface: A small, unlawful tipple.
explanation.walkthrough: Mainly Irish and Scottish usage for an unlicensed drinking den.
explanation.definitionFit: An unlicensed bar or drinking den, especially in Ireland, Scotland or South Africa.

parts.note: secondary is read as belonging to a second, a brief instant, so warmth of an instant, the passion of the moment

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names the excitement or passion felt at a particular instant, here jokingly a second's worth of heat.

clue.text: One not in favour had alternative article first

indicators.note: first says the piece meaning article is placed ahead of the one meaning alternative

parts.note: an article is a thing or object
or is the word that introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: An opponent who had another item put before him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had' is a link; 'first' puts OBJECT ahead of OR, against the clue order.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who raises protests is opposed to the proposal, the opposite of a supporter.

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the word got is written backwards

parts.note: ether is an early general anaesthetic

explanation.surface: Recovered from the anaesthetic at the same moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns GOT into TOG; then ETHER follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing things at the same time is doing them jointly, in unison.

definitions.meaning: included as a part of a whole

explanation.surface: Something given physical form and included.
explanation.definitionFit: To give tangible form to an idea, or to include something as part of a body.

clue.text: Did some agricultural work while the herds were stampeding

indicators.note: stampeding herds run in disorder, so the letters of the herds are scattered

explanation.surface: A farmer was busy while cattle ran wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Beating grain from cut cereal crops is a farm task done at harvest.

clue.text: Man putting contents of vessel into mug

definitions.text: Man putting contents of vessel into mug

parts.words: Man putting contents of vessel into mug
parts.note: looks like a man filling a cup, but describes a drinking vessel moulded in the shape of a seated man

explanation.surface: A fellow pouring a drink into his cup.
explanation.walkthrough: A traditional English pottery beer mug shaped like a stout man in a tricorn hat.
explanation.definitionFit: This pottery beer vessel is modelled as a seated man, so the man and the mug are one object.

definitions.meaning: having a tail, as a dog has

explanation.definitionFit: To shadow someone is to follow them; and an animal with a tail is described this way.

parts.note: reads as an animal that frightens, but means a burrowing mammal whose name also means to pester

explanation.definitionFit: A black-and-white burrowing mammal shares its name with the verb for pestering someone.

clue.text: Pull bolt connector used in coupling railway vehicles

definitions.text: connector used in coupling railway vehicles

parts.note: to draw is to pull
a bar is a bolt for a door

explanation.surface: A rail engineer pulls a bolt on a coupling.
explanation.definitionFit: This rigid link joins a locomotive or tractor to the vehicle it hauls.

clue.text: Theologian overdrawn, say, coming up inside took evasive action

indicators.note: inside places the following pieces within the theologian's letters

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree
OD is a bank statement abbreviation for overdrawn

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up means written upwards, so the abbreviation for say is reversed

parts.note: say means for example, abbreviated eg

explanation.surface: A broke theologian, rising, dodged trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' turns EG into GE; OD and GE go 'inside' DD.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid something by moving quickly aside is to evade it.

clue.text: Not willing to produce a few lines

parts.note: a verse is a short group of lines of poetry

explanation.surface: Reluctant to write a short poem.
explanation.definitionFit: Being opposed to or reluctant about something means unwilling.

clue.text: Pointed out remarkable dedication in which nothing was missing

indicators.note: remarkable suggests the letters are re-marked, so they are placed in a new order
was missing says the letter for nothing is absent from dedication

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A remarkable devotion with nothing lacking was singled out.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop O from DEDICATION ('nothing was missing') to give DEDICATIN, then 'remarkable' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: To show or point to something is to signal it.

definitions.meaning: to decorate food with herbs as a finishing touch
a decoration or accompaniment served with food

explanation.definitionFit: To decorate a dish, or the decoration itself, such as parsley on a plate.

clue.text: German painter or doctor going round river

indicators.note: going round says the doctor's letters surround the river

parts.note: the Ure is a Yorkshire river, a common crossword river

explanation.surface: Either an artist from Germany or a medic circling a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' is a link between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Albrecht, the Nuremberg Renaissance artist famed for engravings, is the painter meant.

clue.text: The league created by Conan Doyle?

definitions.text: The league created by Conan Doyle?

parts.words: The league created by Conan Doyle?
parts.note: points to the Sherlock Holmes story of a sham society for men with ginger hair

explanation.surface: A sports league founded by the creator of Sherlock Holmes.
explanation.definitionFit: The Holmes story title names a league of men with ginger hair; the word describes their hair colour.
